contracts.model: mandatory focusRequest; open increments only on focus=true, retains count on unfocused open; close/exclusive/toggle/closeAll clear to0; snapshotOf omits counts; applySnapshot resets to0
contracts.construction: shellPlugin defines document scope, token, state initialShellState and createShellController; current existing factory already constructs it
contracts.events: controller state change diff; opens have id/props, closes id only; menu closes before opens; repeated focus and prop changes produce no opening event
contracts.prototype: Current plain object access observes inherited toString/valueOf. Preserve named existing adversarial input and exact current output; do not normalize or copy shell rules locally.
contracts.identity: Ignored model operations return identical state; memoByKey preserves unrelated public record; repeated focused open produces new record/list; snapshot memoized until state changes
contracts.retirement: Original action-envelope adapter is private old lens, not a shipping parity target. Full inputs and outcomes archived with replacement explicitly distinguished.
